name: Flippin' Pizza La Costa
notes: 4 photos, all of the same full-menu board; 1.jpg and 2.jpg are identical high-res shots used as the source. 3.jpg is a phone screenshot of a Google image search result (marked up with pen circles) for an older, different-priced version of this menu and was not used. 4.jpg is another photo of the same item list but with different (lower) prices, likely an older price sheet; skipped in favor of the clearer 1/2 pricing. Pie prices vary by size (XL/Med/GF/Slice) and are keyed by tier (Cheese/Pepperoni/Signature) rather than per named pizza, so price was omitted for named hand-tossed pies.
